summary: After the handoff-voice instruction rewrite, bidirectional alignment still holds. Material goals stay in instruction.md; sticky/lag/refuse paths, live /readyz vs dump accepting_checkout, and the failover-status.json schema are discoverable from the referenced runbook and are meaningfully asserted across the F2P/P2P suite. No material phantoms, untested requirements, or grading-relevant ambiguities. Remaining gaps are advisory only (sticky TTL expiry, on-disk healed accepting flag, weak max_lag_lsn naming P2P).

evidence.observation: Two short paragraphs: incident symptoms with evidence paths, /app/ha scope, pins alias, runbook pointer; preserve manage.py and checkout/health/ready routes and history; one fenced writer, card-safe /readyz, confirmation matches writes, one capture per attempt_id; follow runbook sticky/lag/refuse and write /app/ha/out/failover-status.json per runbook object.

Operator cutover contract: sync_standby/cutover/dump_failover; fence lease (owner_node, epoch); pins key sticky:shopper:<id> not django_session; sticky_seconds and max_lag_lsn; blank attempt reject; capture blocked when order write_lsn ahead of primary wal_lsn; /healthz vs live /readyz gates; dump accepting_checkout stricter conjunction; exact failover-status.json field set.
Pager evidence for AZ-B writer, replica place, OPEN after pay, dual captures, half-finished sync with writable standby lease; supports instruction current-state claims without a repair map.
Scraped lines corroborate replica POST place, confirmation OPEN on replica, capture twice for att-inc-20001/20007/20012, sync copying writable fence, /readyz equated to /healthz.
sticky_seconds=5, max_lag_lsn=25, incident_min_order_id=19980; runbook points at this file for sticky budget; tests use the same lag/incident bounds.

28 F2P + 6 P2P behaviors: writer-only mutations, sticky pins vs session, seq-gap readability, sync without writable lease, cutover epoch/demotion, capture idempotency and seq gate, /readyz 503/200 vs /healthz, dump schema and accepting conjunctions, preserve manage/routes/schema/blank-attempt.
Classification-only map; used for F2P/P2P ownership labels, not as coverage authority.
PASS requires complete forward/reverse matrices, instruction/docs boundary walk, and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS; advisory LOWs may accompany PASS.
Instruction may keep a short handoff and delegate protocol/schema detail to legitimate runbook docs; material goals must remain in the work request.

findings.criterion: Runbook sticky_seconds TTL is not behaviorally asserted after expiry; tests check immediate writer confirmation and pin presence.
findings.why_it_matters: A sticky pin that never expires could still pass current asserts. Advisory; read-your-writes and pin-store location are covered.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: after sticky_seconds elapse with eligible lag, allow idle confirmation alias replica.

findings.criterion: Submitted /app/ha/out/failover-status.json is checked for runbook keys; healed accepting_checkout=true is asserted via dump_failover in-test, not on the transferred artifact.
findings.why_it_matters: A schema-valid but still-refusing on-disk dump could coexist with a correct dump_failover implementation. Advisory; dump semantics are graded.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert ROOT out/failover-status.json accepting_checkout true after heal path.

findings.criterion: test_p2p_zero_gap_budget_hides_tiny_lag only asserts max_lag_lsn presence in config/runbook; lag gating behavior is covered by other F2P tests.
findings.why_it_matters: Name suggests a zero-budget metamorphic check that is not executed. Advisory; material lag contract remains tested elsewhere.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: mutate max_lag_lsn to 0 and assert standby_readable false for tiny gap, or rename the P2P.
